Silver's comments follow new polling that underscored Democrats' current momentum. A survey from YouGov/The Economist released last week shows that in a general congressional vote, 40 percent would pick the democratic candidate, and 34 percent would pick the Republican candidate. The survey shows that 10 percent were not sure and 15 percent would not vote.

The poll surveyed 1,559 U.S. adults from July 25 to July 27, 2026, and had a margin of error of 3.3 percent.

## Polling averages update

All numbers are as of 1:00 PM Eastern on Aug. 14, 2026.

### 2026 U.S. House generic ballot

The Democratic margin in the 2026 U.S. House generic ballot rounded to 6 percentage points this week. Both Democrats and Republicans saw some improvement in their numbers, with Democrats increasing from 49 last week to 49.4 this week, and Republicans increasing from 42.5 to 43.3.
